title: Sampled process-tree resources for retained-source CPU baseline
question: What process-tree resources were observed during the actual native122 retained Grinstead-Snell CPU source run?
method: Wrap the actual command from process creation; sample parent/descendant own CPU and proportional memory every0.5seconds; retain unavailable/disappeared processes and command exit.
commands: uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-04_m1-cpu-resources/sample_tree.py --interval 0.5 --out docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-04_m1-cpu-resources/ordinary-001.jsonl -- uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-04_m1-cpu-readings/run.py grinstead-snell attempt-010
